description: This file defines the ContentType class for handling Markdown content in Confluence format, extending a base ContentType class and adding JavaScript for rendering MathJax/KaTeX and Mermaid diagrams within Confluence pages.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Class responsible for handling Markdown content type in Confluence, with custom conversion and JavaScript injection.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates and returns a CommonMarkConverter instance with configuration.

methods.name: addJS
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code for rendering KaTeX and Mermaid diagrams in Confluence.

methods.name: doConversion
methods.description: Performs content conversion, appends JavaScript if necessary, and resets configuration flags.
